title: Tom's Morning
text:
Tom likes to run. Every morning he runs to the park. He jumps over the small puddles. Then he stops under a big tree.

After the park, Tom goes home. He eats breakfast and reads a book. Then he climbs the stairs to his room. He sleeps early at night.

What does Tom do after the park?
How does Tom probably feel about running?
options: He is too tired to do it

questions.text: What kind of day does Tom probably have?
options: A cold and wet day at school

paragraph_translations: Tom gosta de correr. Toda manhã ele corre até o parque. Ele pula sobre as pequenas poças. Depois ele para embaixo de uma árvore grande.
Depois do parque, Tom vai para casa. Ele come o café da manhã e lê um livro. Depois ele sobe as escadas até o seu quarto. Ele dorme cedo à noite.
